title: Clips2Story: Training-Free Video Storyboarding and Editing Using Multimodal Retrieval-Embedded Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video editors often work with large collections of fragmented footage and must select and organize relevant clips into a coherent story. However, many existing video editing and summarization methods assume a temporally ordered source video and aim to preserve its original narrative and temporal structure. In this paper, we introduce Clips2Story, a training-free, LLM-based pipeline that enables users to create keyword-specified short videos from a pool of video clips. Given a pool of clips and a user-specified keyword, we first extract text-based multimodal descriptors for each clip and retrieve the clips most relevant to the keyword. We then provide the textual descriptors of these candidate clips to an LLM, which selects and arranges them into an editable storyboard with connective narrations. Finally, we assemble the selected clips and retrieve accompanying visuals for the narrations to compose the output video. To evaluate the prop

translated_title: Clips2Story：基于多模态检索嵌入式生成的免训练视频故事板制作与编辑
translated_abstract: 视频编辑人员通常需要处理大量碎片化的素材集合，并必须从中选择和组织相关片段以形成连贯的故事。然而，许多现有的视频编辑和摘要方法都假设源视频在时间上是有序的，并旨在保留其原始的叙事和时间结构。在本文中，我们提出了Clips2Story，这是一个无需训练、基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，使用户能够从视频片段池中创建指定关键词的短视频。给定一个片段池和用户指定的关键词，我们首先为每个片段提取基于文本的多模态描述符，并检索与关键词最相关的片段。然后，我们将这些候选片段的文本描述符提供给LLM，由其选择并排列这些片段，形成带有连贯旁白叙述的可编辑故事板。最后，我们组装所选片段，并为旁白检索配套的视觉画面，以合成输出视频。为了评估所提出的方法……
tldr: Clips2Story提出了一种无需训练的LLM流水线，通过多模态描述符检索与关键词相关的视频片段，并自动编排成带有旁白叙述的可编辑故事板和连贯短视频。
en_tdlr: Clips2Story is a training-free LLM-based pipeline that retrieves keyword-relevant clips from a pool of fragmented footage via multimodal descriptors and arranges them into an editable storyboard with connective narrations to compose a coherent short video.
